items.title: The Lakers beat the Heat 138-117.
items.author: Edwin Garcia
items.body_excerpt:
The Lakers beat the Heat 138-117.
Luka Dončić was incredible again. He had 42 points, 7 rebounds, and 13 assists. Austin Reaves had 27 points and 5 assists. Walker Kessler had a double-double with 15 points and 15 rebounds.
